marks.q: Drilling is expected to commence on or around 21 June 2026 and continue for approximately three weeks, subject to operational and weather conditions.

As we enter 2026, the Company is focused and positioned to execute. We retain a differentiated gasification platform with long-term exposure to the global energy transition, while adding a new portfolio of mining assets capable of delivering nearer-term operational catalysts.

Our objective for the remainder of the year is clear: maintain financial discipline, continue executing our exploration programmes and deploy capital into the opportunities we believe have the potential to materially increase the underlying value of the Company for shareholders.
